frame: x = metres east of the west edge, y = metres north of the south edge (eqc grid metres), z = elevation in m. True east-west ground distance = eqc distance x cos(lat) = x 0.9965 (0.35 % shorter); north-south is exact.

pois.name: Sulfate unit to boxwork contact
pois.description: Where Curiosity left the layered sulfate unit and entered the boxwork region (sol 4534). NASA's blog dates boxwork campaign Phase 1 to sols 4534-4570. GSA 2025 abstract URL to be added (not verified here).
pois.science_value: Key geologic boundary; start of the boxwork campaign and of our EVA box route.

pois.name: Altadena (first boxwork drill)
pois.description: First drill sample of the boxwork campaign, on a ridge edge, June 2025. Drill sol 4564 is INFERRED (blog: drilling on the second sol of the 4563-4565 plan; post-brush image sol 4561).

pois.name: Monte Grande (boxwork hollow)
pois.description: Boxwork hollow studied in Oct 2025; Mastcam mosaics of its walls. Hollow drill target Valle de la Luna lies here.
pois.science_value: Example of a boxwork hollow: compare with ridges for how boxwork formed.

pois.name: Valle de la Luna (44th drill hole)
pois.description: Drill target in the Monte Grande hollow, drilled around 18-19 Oct 2025 (Mastcam image of the hole on sol 4693); Curiosity's 44th hole. Exact drill sol not stated.
pois.science_value: Hollow sample for the ridge-vs-hollow comparison.

pois.name: Nevado Sajama (ridge-top drill)
pois.description: Ridge-top drill target; drilling completed on sol 4718 (13 Nov 2025) after APXS, ChemCam and MAHLI checks.
pois.science_value: Ridge sample for the ridge-vs-hollow comparison.

pois.name: Nevado Sajama 2 (second ridge drill)
pois.description: Second drill at Nevado Sajama; MAHLI image sol 4803 (9 Feb 2026); final activities completed that week before the last boxwork phase.
pois.science_value: Repeat sample at the same ridge site.

pois.name: Nazca (49th drill hole)
pois.description: 49th drill hole, sols 5050-5055 per the NASA blog title. Details NOT verified (page not read); position = rover waypoint at sol 5050.
pois.science_value: Bedrock sample just above the boxwork (per a later blog, to verify).
